experiment: MARINENETMS-BN: MARINE-Net original architecture (40 BatchNorm2d), trained under the recipe of XF / XFIN seed 1 (R3 loss, fp32, cosine floor 2e-8); compared with the AT-Trunk run xf_attrunk_r3_fp32_s1 and, across variants, with the other MARINE-Net variant of the same seed

baseline_reference.note: the result.json of the AT-Trunk run of this seed (train + val_A manifests only) is read by the preflight and the gate for the args pairing and must have its pinned SHA-256; no other run's result.json is opened (the MARINE-Net R3 AMP runs are deliberately not opened)
baseline_reference.comparison_rule: descriptive paired report only (Option A): no class, threshold or margin; all Val-A numbers are exploratory

data.manifest_scope: ONLY the train and val_A manifests are hashed / loaded; val_B, val and val_clean are removed from train_v2.MANIFESTS before train_v2.main() runs; UIEB is never referenced

loss.implementation: original_repo/marine_net_model.py :: MARINELoss (unchanged, SHA-256 pinned) via train_v2.build exactly as for the earlier MARINE-Net R3 runs: MARINE-Net has NO final_output_only attribute, so the loss is MARINELoss itself (NOT FinalOutputLoss) and train_v2.ZeroLoss replaces the zero-weight perceptual term
loss.equation: 1.0*L1(clamp(pred),clamp(y)) + 0.5*(1-SSIM11) + 0.4*GradientL1 + 0.2*ColourStats(mean MSE + std MSE) + 0.3*(L1(cnn_output,y) + L1(inr_output,y)) [ACTIVE: real branch outputs] [+ 0.0*perceptual]
loss.clamp: pred and target are clamped to [0,1] inside the loss; MARINE-Net clamps enhanced, cnn_output and inr_output inside the model as well
loss.precision: fp32 forward and fp32 loss (amp False, no GradScaler); convolution TF32 is left at the PyTorch default and recorded under 'runtime'
loss.non_finite_guard: train_v2.step is replaced by the reviewed XR guarded_step wrapped by a recorder: clip_grad_norm_ as before, a non-finite total norm raises FloatingPointError BEFORE optimizer.step (train_v2.step would step with NaN gradients under fp32)
loss.r3_internal_nan_guards: MARINELoss replaces a non-finite term by a constant; that masking is part of the R3 definition and is NOT altered; the driver and gate additionally stop on non-finite gradient norms
loss.auxiliary_terms: ACTIVE for MARINE-Net (cnn_output and inr_output are real tensors); exactly zero for AT-Trunk (final_output_only). This difference is inherent to the two designs and is not removed

clip_logging.clipped_means: clip_grad_norm_ rescaled the gradient (scale = min(1, clip / (norm + 1e-6)) < 1)
clip_logging.note: observation only: the recorder reads the pre-clip norm that the step already returns; no training arithmetic is changed; no earlier run logged this, so there is no baseline fraction

unchanged: recipe values: AdamW lr 2e-4, weight decay 1e-5, 3-epoch warm-up, cosine floor 2e-8, grad-clip 1.0, batch 4, no accumulation, 100 epochs, fp32 (amp False, no GradScaler): exactly those of XF / XFIN
MARINELoss (R3 weights, SHA-256 pinned) with train_v2.ZeroLoss as perceptual term; NOT wrapped in FinalOutputLoss

data: the LSUI train (3,463) and Val-A (166) manifests; paired horizontal flips only (no jitter); the data order (sampler seeded with seed*10007+epoch) and the per-sample flip decisions are derived from the seed only, so they equal those of the XF / XFIN run of seed 1
frozen evaluator train_v2.evaluate (256x256, fp32, TF32 off, clamp [0,1]) and Val-A best-PSNR checkpoint selection
the MARINE-Net architecture and its forward(); the 40 BatchNorm2d layers
remaining_confounders: MARINE-Net and AT-Trunk differ in several components at once (physics-guided attention vs none, INR branch vs none, scalar fusion vs affine colour heads + detail branch, parameter count 2.61 M vs 1.95 M): the 2 x 2 design separates 'architecture family' from 'normalisation', NOT any single component
the auxiliary CNN / INR L1 loss terms (0.3 each) are ACTIVE for MARINE-Net and exactly zero for AT-Trunk (final_output_only); this is an inherent property of the two designs and is not removed

the initial weights differ between MARINE-Net and AT-Trunk (different constructors / random-number streams); within a variant the BatchNorm and InstanceNorm MARINE-Net models share bit-identical convolution, linear and INR initialisation for the same seed
the normalisation mechanism is not separated: the swap removes batch coupling and the train / eval statistics mismatch AND adds per-image channel normalisation
MARINE-Net was designed with BatchNorm; no tuning for InstanceNorm was done, and full-channel InstanceNorm2d on all 40 sites is only one possible replacement
the existing MARINE-Net R3 AMP runs (cosine floor 1e-6) are NOT matched baselines and are not opened by this tooling; these runs replace them as the matched baseline

n = 3 seeds per cell, no significance claim possible; Val-A selects the checkpoint (best-epoch selection inflates noisy curves); cuDNN is not bitwise deterministic; the fp32 convolutions may use TF32 (PyTorch default, recorded in marinenet_loss_config.json)
MARINE-Net's seed-to-seed spread was large in the earlier AMP runs (about 1.8 dB); the fp32 spread is unknown until the runs exist

code.untracked_dependency_note: original_repo/ is git-ignored; its SHA-256 is pinned in xr_config and re-verified before launch, while training, after training and in the gate

parameter_count.source: reports/stage_1_report.md (2,609,401 trainable + 12,840 BatchNorm buffers = 2,622,241 state elements); the tooling also compares them with the instantiated models

decision_rule.status: NONE (Option A: descriptive paired reporting only)
decision_rule.reporting: v2_tools/marinenetms_paired_summary.py: exact per-seed deltas, mean, range, sign pattern, largest absolute delta; no class, threshold, margin, significance or equivalence claim
decision_rule.delta_convention: delta = FIRST minus SECOND run family of the SAME seed, computed from the exact values in each run's history.jsonl; for PSNR (dB) and SSIM alike a positive delta means the first family is higher. Pairs: norm_effect_in_marinenet = marinenet_in - marinenet_bn; norm_effect_in_attrunk = xfin - xf; arch_effect_under_bn = xf - marinenet_bn; arch_effect_under_in = xfin - marinenet_in. Contrast: interaction_contrast = norm_effect_in_attrunk - norm_effect_in_marinenet (per seed)

differs_from_reference.architecture: MARINE-Net (physics-guided attention, INR branch, scalar fusion) instead of AT-Trunk (colour heads + detail branch, no PGA, no INR): several components differ at once
differs_from_reference.loss: auxiliary CNN / INR L1 terms active (MARINE-Net) vs zero (AT-Trunk)
